panels.name: Most Recent Alerts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/CB/Defense
| json field=_raw "url" as URL 
| parse field=URL "*/investigate" as server
| json field=_raw "threatInfo.incidentId" as incident
| format("%s/alerts?s[c][QUERY_STRING_TYPE][0]=alert ID:%s", server, incident) as Alert_URL
| replace( Alert_URL," ", "%20") as Alert_URL
//| tourl(Alert_URL ,"View") as Alert_URL
| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.deviceName" as Device
| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.groupName" as DeviceGroup
| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.deviceType" as Device_OS
| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.email" as User
| json field=_raw "threatInfo.score" as Score
| json field=_raw "threatInfo.summary" as Reason
| json field=_raw "threatInfo.time" as ThreatTime
| formatDate(fromMillis(ThreatTime), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as Threat_Time 
| json field=_raw "eventDescription" as Description
| parse field=description "[Severity: *]" as Severity
| json field=_raw "source" as Source nodrop
| json field=_raw "ruleName" as Rule nodrop
| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.targetPriorityType" as Target_Priority nodrop
| json field=_raw "threatInfo.incidentId" as Incident_ID nodrop
| where Device matches {{Device}} and User matches {{User}} and Score matches "*" and Incident_ID matches {{Incident_ID}} and Device_OS matches "*" and DeviceGroup matches DeviceGroup and Rule matches "*" and Source matches "*" and Target_Priority matches "*" and Severity matches {{Severity}}| count by Threat_Time, Alert_URL, Device, Target_Priority,Device_OS, User, Score, Reason, Severity 
| fields - _count

panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/CB/Defense

| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.deviceName" as Device nodrop
| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.email" as User nodrop
| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.targetPriorityType" as Target_Priority nodrop
| json field=_raw "source" as Source nodrop
| json field=_raw "ruleName" as Rule nodrop
| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.groupName" as DeviceGroup nodrop
| json field=_raw "deviceInfo.deviceType" as Device_OS nodrop
| json field=_raw "threatInfo.incidentId" as Incident_ID nodrop
| json field=_raw "eventDescription" as description nodrop
| parse field=description "[Severity: *]" as Severity nodrop
| where Device matches {{Device}} and User matches {{User}} and Score matches "*" and Incident_ID matches {{Incident_ID}} and Device_OS matches "*" and DeviceGroup matches DeviceGroup and Rule matches "*" and Source matches "*" and Target_Priority matches "*" 
| where Severity = "Threat"
and Score >= 0
| toInt(Score)
| if(Score > 0 AND Score < 11, "0 - 10", "N/A") AS %"Threat Score"
| if(Score > 10 AND Score < 21, "11 - 20", %"Threat Score") AS %"Threat Score"
| if(Score > 20 AND Score < 31, "21 - 30", %"Threat Score") AS %"Threat Score"
| if(Score > 30 AND Score < 41, "31 - 40", %"Threat Score") AS %"Threat Score"
| if(Score > 40 AND Score < 51, "41 - 50", %"Threat Score") AS %"Threat Score"
| if(Score > 50 AND Score < 61, "51 - 60", %"Threat Score") AS %"Threat Score"
| if(Score > 60 AND Score < 71, "61 - 70", %"Threat Score") AS %"Threat Score"
| if(Score > 70 AND Score < 81, "71 - 80", %"Threat Score") AS %"Threat Score"
| if(Score > 80 AND Score < 91, "81 - 90", %"Threat Score") AS %"Threat Score"
| if(Score > 90, "91 - 100", %"Threat Score") AS %"Threat Score"
| count AS %"Threats Detected" BY %"Threat Score"
| sort BY +%"Threat Score"
